title: Settings and flags
clearDescription: The value set for {{label}} is removed; the setting falls back to the next level.
noOverrides: Nothing is set: the default applies.

mode.label: Applies as
mode.rollout: A gradual rollout (a share of users)

rollout.label: Share of principals
rollout.description: The flag is on for this percentage of the tenant's principals; the same ones every time, and raising it never switches anyone off.

scopeId.user: Choose a user or an API client.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.empty: There is nothing to set for yourself.

hiddenNote: Only people who manage settings see this setting.
scopeIdHint: A user or an API client: type a part of a name or an address.

platform.title: All tenants
platform.description: What the deployment's operators set for every tenant. Enforced, it beats every tenant, team and user value (a kill switch); otherwise it is the default for tenants that set nothing.
platform.none: Nothing is set for all tenants.
platform.enforcedHint: Overrides every tenant, team and user value.
platform.removeTitle: Remove the value for all tenants?
platform.removeDescription: Each tenant's own value, or the default, applies again.
platform.operatorsOnly: Only the deployment's operators (signed in to the operator tenant) can set this for all tenants.

show.label: Show
show.flagsHint: Turn a flag on for the whole tenant, a team or one person, or roll it out gradually: Edit, then “Applies as: a gradual rollout”.

rules.title: Targeting rules
rules.description: Switch the flag by attribute, before the values above. Rules are checked in order and the first whose conditions all hold decides; whoever matches none gets the value below. A rule that cannot be checked (an attribute the person does not have) never matches.
rules.platformDescription: Checked before the value for all tenants, below an enforced value and each tenant's own values. Roles are each tenant's own: they are not offered here.
rules.rolloutHint: On for this percentage of the people the rule matches (the same ones every time); off for the rest of them.
